implications.text: Provide full-coverage independent reference ratings, retain original ratings before adjudication and expose denominators and reviewer AI exposure.
Separate retrieval, inference, applicability and rubric ambiguity errors, while matching complete evidence exposure in configured prompt conditions.
Keep repeat consistency distinct from agreement, and treat six projects as six clusters.
Describe contribution as a small provenance-rich six-project same-scope paired-version pilot with explicit lifecycle eligibility and pinned DMP-EVA evaluation; no first-study or exhaustive-gap claim.
